prompt:
Create ONE square contact sheet with exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 equal square cells in row-major order. Each cell has its own white background and generous blank margins; all subjects fit entirely inside cell with at least 12 percent clearance. Straight equal grid boundaries; no grid lines. Consistent warm watercolor educational picture-book illustration, clear accurate object anatomy, restrained background, natural colors, readable at 256px. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no watermark. Do not swap or combine cells. Subjects in exact row-major order:
1. Japanese jack mackerel, Trachurus japonicus, full side profile: streamlined silver body, blue-green back, forked tail, two dorsal fins, visible curved lateral line with hard scutes toward tail.
2. Whitespotted conger eel, Conger myriaster, full elongated brown body with a neat row of small white spots along the side, pale belly, continuous dorsal-tail-anal fin, pointed tapering tail, small pectoral fin, no pelvic fins. Fully visible curved body.
3. Apatosaurus life restoration, full side view: massive heavy four-legged body, long thick neck held forward, small elongated low head, very long slender whiplike tail. No back plates, no horns. Muted gray-brown speculative coloration.
4. Ankylosaurus life restoration, full side view: low wide four-legged body, short neck, bony armour knobs across back, small triangular head, short stout legs, long tail ending in broad rounded bony club. No upright stegosaurus plates. Muted earthy speculative coloration.
5. A tabletop mirror clearly reflecting a small red ball sitting in front of it; reflection has matching geometry.
6. Two soft folded terrycloth towels, one pale blue and one cream.
7. A wooden measuring ruler with many evenly spaced short measurement tick marks, no numerals.
8. A clear triangular drafting ruler beside a pencil and one straight line on paper, no text.
9. A simple wooden shape sorting puzzle board with circle triangle and square matching pieces.
10. A partially completed jigsaw puzzle showing a simple house, with loose interlocking puzzle pieces.
11. Close up of a jacket zipper: two toothed tracks join below a clearly visible slider, open above it.
12. A small canvas tote bag with two short carrying handles.
13. A roll of adhesive tape, loose end peeling off the roll.
14. A small tool box beside hammer and screwdriver, plain safe tabletop.
15. A twin bell alarm clock on a bedside table, hands and tick marks but no numerals.
16. Child sitting safely in car rear seat with a correctly fitted three point shoulder and lap seatbelt, no neck contact.
